parameters.text:
={{ $json.body }}

Return a JSON object with a required "labels" array. Every array item must be exactly "Inquiry", "Partnership", or "Notification". An empty array is allowed. Return only the JSON object.

messageValues.message:
Your task is to categorize the message according to the following labels.

Partnership - email about sponsored content, cooperation etc.
Inquiry - email about products, services.
Notification - email that doesn't require response. 

One email can have more than one label. Return only label names in JSON format, nothing else. Do not make things up.

parameters.content:
## Gmail AI Labeler

Select the same Gmail mailbox for the trigger, body read, label catalog and label update. Create Inquiry, Partnership and Notification labels first. Every minute, native Gmail Trigger1.4 emits at most25 messages and keeps a bounded pending queue. Ordinary drafts are included; outgoing-only, scheduled, spam and trash messages are excluded. See README for differences from Open Flow history polling, backlog/failed-fetch limits and recovery. All bodies and classifications are read and checked before any label write. Labels are additive; empty classifications do not write. Configure OpenAI Chat. gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 shuts down January14,2027: switch and recheck an available model in both formats. No workflow-level retries or automatic failed-execution replay. Message bodies are sent to the model service.
